title: Plates Received
body: Joseph Smith reports receiving the plates near the Hill Cumorah.

title: Aaronic Priesthood
body: Conferral of the Aaronic Priesthood upon Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery.

title: Church Organized
body: Organization of the Church of Christ at Fayette, New York.

title: Kirtland Temple Dedication
body: Dedication of the Kirtland Temple; subsequent visions reported.

title: Martyrdom at Carthage Jail
body: Joseph and Hyrum Smith are killed in Carthage Jail.
